$comment: Duskrunner Radiant Kitsune variant rig. The approved exact-pose portrait is painted into the normal Radiant Kitsune parts; the hood and upper cowl follow the head, while the lower cowl and rear garment follow the body.
$underpaintComment: UNDERPAINT: the parts are cut along their outlines and overlap their neighbours only in a ~2,100px disc at each joint, so nothing lies behind the rest of a seam and every idle breath opened a dark sliver at the shoulders, mane and hips. rive-mcp grows each part up to 48 canvas px under the parts of its own line drawn over it, in its own edge colours — hidden at rest, revealed as more of the part in motion. Pivots are measured before the fill and do not move. 48, not more: measured across six species and five clips, 48 removed slits on every clip; 96 began adding them back on bigfoot (art-pipeline.md section 6.4).
